title: The ds-slot font cache fetches only from fonts.gstatic.com, whatever URL a paused request carries (CodeQL alert of release #395, round 3)
steps: S1: From the repository root run: node --test --test-reporter=tap packages/design/tracy-ds-slot/test/cdp-font-host.test.mjs
S2: Record the exit code, the '# tests', '# pass', '# fail' lines and the result of each test named in run.tests.
expect: Every named test is 'ok': a fonts.gstatic.com address is kept as it was; a look-alike host, a user-info trick, plain http, another host carrying the gstatic URL in its path, a metadata address, an empty string and undefined all give null; a path starting with '@' or '//' still fetches from fonts.gstatic.com.

selectors.ds-slot: fontFetchUrl (packages/design/tracy-ds-slot/scripts/cdp.mjs), used by cachedFont for Fetch.requestPaused on fonts.gstatic.com

evidence: CodeQL check of the release PR #395 after #413: server-side request forgery at packages/design/tracy-ds-slot/scripts/cdp.mjs:32 (`fetch(url)` with the paused request's URL). With the host check removed from fontFetchUrl, 'fontFetchUrl refuses every other host' fails.
fence: Mechanism only: which address the cache fetches. Not covered: the CodeQL run itself (no CodeQL CLI on the machine) and a live browser lane.

tests: fontFetchUrl keeps the fetch on fonts.gstatic.com
